title_original: 장애예술인 문화예술 활동 지원에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Procedure for Supporting Costs for Improving Cultural Facilities)

(1) Applicants seeking to receive financial support for improving the accessibility of cultural facilities for disabled artists, as stipulated in Article 12(2) and Article 6(2) of the "Act on Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Disabled Artists" (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") and in Article 6(2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree"), must submit a support application form in Form 1 of the Annex, attached with the following documents, to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism or the head of a local government, in accordance with Article 6(2) of the Decree.
1. Current status of the cultural facility to be improved
2. Improvement plan
3. Budget

(2) After receiving the support application form as described in (1), the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism or the head of a local government shall, considering the validity of the improvement plan and budget, decide whether to provide financial support for improving cultural facilities and notify the applicant of the decision.
